summary: The silence broke, but ALTR broke it, not her. Stephski's 8/14 pre-invoice nudge and 8/15 Aug 1-14 invoice were the first contact; Hailey came back on 8/18 after 14 days quiet (last word before that was 'Wire sent!' on 8/4). She returned with two things at once: a forwarded fan screenshot ('Hi! Just got this') and confusion about the invoice, because Stephski's 8/15 message announced yet another change - 'Please note an update to the account number' - only six weeks after the 7/1 BofA switch that was billed as 'last change I promise!'. Her direct question, 'Do i wire it over to the same place i sent last month?', went unanswered by Stephski for the rest of the week. Mayson tagged '@stephskiii ^' twice (8/19 and 8/20), promised 'I'll get you an answer shortly' at 3:35am on 8/19, and Hailey still had to re-ask on 8/20 before Derrek finally answered 'yes / thats fine' - roughly 50 hours after she asked, and in direct contradiction of the written instruction on the invoice. She wired that same afternoon, 5 days after invoice, inside the 7-day terms and technically not late - but she was told to use the OLD account by the owner after being told in writing to use the NEW one, so receipt of those funds needs verifying before this is called clean. The 7/29 shadowban request was never answered: Vivek's 'Sure share login' on 7/29 is still the last word on it, nobody chased her for the login, and it is now 23 days open. Vivek has posted exactly one message in the 750-message history. Derrek's 8/1 promise of 'plenty of updates starting next week' on the $40k phone farm is now 20 days old with nothing posted. The one clean save of the week was Ronnie, who closed her forwarded fan issue in seven hours.

health.rationale: Down from 68 despite the client re-engaging and paying inside terms, because the week produced a live, in-window re-enactment of her single most-documented complaint - and this time on money. She asked a direct payment question on 8/18 and did not get an answer for ~50 hours, needing two internal '@stephskiii ^' tags and a re-ask before the owner stepped in; that is exactly the 'no one ever responds when i send them here' behaviour she named on 4/22. The answer she got ('yes / thats fine' - send to last month's account) also contradicts the invoice instruction to use an updated account number, so the payment is unconfirmed rather than settled. Meanwhile the 7/29 shadowban ask crossed 23 days untouched with zero chases, and Derrek's phone-farm update is 20 days past his own promise. Credit where due: she is talking again, the wire went out, Ronnie handled the fan escalation same-day and leak-removal shipped on schedule - which is why this is a 3-point slip and not a collapse.
